newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end buoyant, lifted by Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end buoyant, lifted by Telecom.

text.p: 1730 GMT - Shares ended buoyant, with Portugal Telecom particularly strong, as optimism returned to the market after a number of quiet sessions.
*The March futures contract closed just over one percent up at 6,104, while the .PSI20 index of leading blue chips was up 0.94 percent at 6,106.23.
*Dealers said that the market had benefitted from the firm international trend, and if New York closed higher on Tuesday, the Lisbon market could gain further tomorrow.
*"If New York closes higher, I think that the (Portuguese) market will rise. These is a lot of demand for the blue chips," said one Lisbon share trader.

*Portugal Telecom jumped 3.5 percent, helped by the strength of the dollar and remarks by Portugal's deputy finance minister that drew the planned next phase of its privatisation back to the market's attention, traders said.
*Fernando Teixeira dos Santos reaffirmed that the 26 percent of Portugal Telecom that the government plans to float later this year could contain a tranche for a planned global ally.

*Civil engineering company Somague soared 10.5 percent after formally announcing on Monday that it was buying A. Silva & Silva's Assocontroi construction company. The acquisition makes Somague Portugal's largest construction company.
